sections.label: Sponsor commitment
sections.description: Sponsor engagement, authority, and decision cadence for the Move.
sections.value: COO role is the accountable sponsor placeholder for this disposable smoke Move. This is not a real Meridian signoff; it validates the signed-in phase workflow.

sections.label: Scope boundary
sections.description: Included and excluded process, user, function, system, or cohort boundaries.
sections.value: P1 scope is limited to proving context-extract generation for member-service agent assist. No candidate promotion, no Active Tenant Access update, no Tower outcome.

sections.label: Success criteria
sections.description: Outcomes, KPIs, and directional targets that Discovery must validate.
sections.value: Pass criteria: context extract artifact created; attached evidence has an evidence id; candidate version is null; deliverables are queued; repeat run skips existing extract.

sections.label: Stakeholder map
sections.description: Business, IT, finance, risk, and operational stakeholders needed for Discovery.
sections.value: Roles only: COO sponsor, VP Member Operations owner, CIO/CDO data-platform reviewer, privacy/compliance reviewer.

sections.label: Decision rights
sections.description: Who can approve scope, investment, design decisions, and phase advancement.
sections.value: This smoke authorizes only a disposable workflow proof. It does not authorize investment, implementation, realized-value claims, or production rollout.

sections.label: Evidence plan
sections.description: Evidence families, interviews, workshops, extracts, or templates needed next.
sections.value: Use active module context and generated context-extract evidence only. Suggested/excluded/gap material remains review-only and must not be treated as approved evidence.
